title: 2026 MSc Journey Reflections
excerpt:
Time moves quickly in the journey of growth.

Looking back at my MSc in Information Systems at NTU Singapore, it was a blend of hope, anxiety, pressure, and joy — all of which shaped not just my technical capability, but also my character.

Learning became more than academic progression. It became exposure to perspectives across technology, project management, and digital transformation — and a reminder that we grow most when we are stretched beyond comfort.

Like the “ten worlds” in Buddhist thought, human experience in learning and work is dynamic — shifting between struggle, insight, connection, and fulfillment. Each phase contributes to expanding our worldview.

Beyond knowledge, the journey also brought tangible change — career transitions, friendships formed through collaboration, and moments of mutual support that defined the experience as much as the curriculum itself.

In a BANI world, structured learning and lived experience together become a way to build resilience — not just to keep up with change, but to evolve with it.

Now, stepping into the next chapter, the focus is simple:
Build, contribute, and continue growing — with clarity and intent.
body:
## The journey to forging substance through academic pursuit


Time truly flies. In the blink of an eye, it has been 2 years since I started my MSc in Information Systems at [**Nanyang Technological University Singapore**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/ntusg/). I have unofficially graduated and am waiting for the graduation ceremony. There are so many flavours that I experienced - hope, anxiety, stress, joy. A food for thought, isn’t this what makes us human?


## When you’re learning, you’re happy


There is a Buddhist concept called the ten worlds, in which there is the world of voice hearers. Buddha used to share the Middle Way with his disciples, and they were elated upon hearing it, as it could free them from Samsara. It is the same kind of joy when we hear seasoned veterans share knowledge, perspectives, and wisdom to elevate our calibre. It ranges from cutting-edge technology like Blockchain and Digital Transformation to Project Management. The essence is that we are happy when we learn and expand our worldview. As an introvert, I love Dr [**Wing Lam**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/profwinglam/)’s lesson so much that I joined 3 of his modules, as it highly helped me to become more vocal and filled with functional tech knowledge, like hardcore presentations and the in-trend vibe coding.


## Striving for harmonious life


I was filled with hope for the future when I first started out. Anxiety and overwhelming stress started to kick in as I struggled to balance life, new work responsibilities, my master's, and my duties at Soka. I only managed to balance it better in the latter game through conditioning. I’m happy there are joyful moments when we can build friendships. I’m proud that I successfully referred a classmate to [**Cognizant**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/cognizant/) as an SWE even though I had left the role, since he mentioned it was his dream job. I’m happy that there are classmates who cared enough to host lunch sessions at her place even after our last class together. That was only possible by the dynamics and environment set up by [**Phei Sunn (PS) Sim**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pheisunn/), which I’m grateful for.


There are tangible benefits to getting a Master's Program. I took a leap of faith and hopped over to [**Ministry of Digital Development and Information**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/ministry-of-digital-development-and-information/) with a good bump, even though I'm in the mid of the program. Many top-tier firms, with the likes of Google/BCG, state that an MSc increases the chance of getting the role. LinkedIn Statistics states that top tech jobs have about 25-30% of the candidates owns an education higher than Bachelor. In a BANI world, we could strengthen ourselves with the rigour of a part-time education route. They say a smooth sea never made a skillful sailor. When we are forged by fire, we can truly polish the gem in us to shine.


There are friends that stayed together for almost all the group projects and managed to build a deeper bond with. Thankful to have this balance dynamics [**Chua JY Simon**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chua-jy-simon-a92a3b62/) and [**Yong Lin Tam**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yltam98/). There are some friends who helped out when I needed a save - Thanks, [**Chester Liew**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/liewchester/).


## Soaring like a phoenix


I'm a free man roaming the world with a solid rock off my shoulders. Now I am looking for the next mission to pursue. Officially a tech policy developer by day, growth hacker, and exploring the world by night.

title: How automation can 10x Agentic AI Processes
excerpt:
Automation is no longer just about efficiency — it is becoming the operational backbone that enables Agentic AI to scale.
By codifying repetitive, high-volume workflows into automated systems, organisations can shift human effort away from manual execution toward higher-value work: strategic thinking, decision-making, and innovation.
This shift is not theoretical — it is measurable. From onboarding flows to data pipelines, approvals, notifications, and system integrations, automation reduces cost, error rates, and turnaround time while improving consistency and governance.
When combined with Agentic AI, the impact moves beyond task automation into intelligent orchestration — where systems not only execute workflows, but also make contextual decisions dynamically.
The future is not incremental improvement.

It is 10x efficiency, 100x scalability, and end-to-end digital transformation across enterprise ecosystems. 🚀
body:
![how_automation_can_10x_agentic_ai.png](/notion/how-automation-can-10x-agentic-ai-orchestration-0.png)


## Purpose of technology


Technology has always existed to augment human capability and improve productivity. Today, the integration of workflow automation into Agentic AI systems is becoming a major driver of operational efficiency, scalability, and digital transformation.


## Automation is no longer just about reducing manpower — it is about enabling humans to focus on higher-value work.


💡 Repetitive, high-volume operational tasks can now be codified into automated workflows and executed consistently by machines. This allows organisations to redirect human talent toward strategic thinking, discernment, innovation, and decision-making.


Rather than replacing human intelligence, automation amplifies it.


## Singapore’s 2026 AI Vision


This vision aligns strongly with Singapore’s national AI ambitions 🇸🇬. As highlighted by Josephine Teo, Singapore aims to develop 100,000 AI-bilingual workers to seize opportunities in the growing AI economy. Automation will serve as a critical operational backbone that enables Agentic AI systems to scale effectively across enterprises.


### Why does this matter? 


Automation delivers measurable savings in:


✅ Time


✅ Operational Cost


✅ Human Effort


✅ Error Reduction


✅ Service Delivery Speed


Once workflows are designed and integrated, repetitive processes can run continuously with minimal oversight.


For example:


Imagine onboarding a user into an Agentic AI system via FormSG takes 15 minutes manually.


Assuming a Software Engineer earns SGD 6,000/month, 20 working days/month, each 15-minute onboarding process costs approximately SGD 9.38 in labour value. At just 100 onboarding requests, automation could potentially save:


💰 SGD 937.50 from a single workflow touchpoint alone.


Now imagine this across:


🔄 Data entry


📩 Notifications


📝 Case creation


🔗 System integrations


✅ Validation checks


📊 Reporting pipelines


⚡ Approval workflows


The true power of automation lies in scale.


Across enterprise ecosystems, thousands of repetitive touchpoints exist daily. When multiplied across operations, the cumulative savings in manpower, turnaround time, and operational overhead become substantial.


Beyond cost reduction, automation also:


✔️ Improves consistency


✔️ Enhances auditability


✔️ Reduces human error


✔️ Strengthens governance


✔️ Accelerates service delivery


Combined with Agentic AI, organisations can move beyond simple automation into intelligent orchestration — where systems not only execute workflows, but also make contextual decisions dynamically.


The goal is not incremental improvement but


🚀 10x operational efficiency


🚀 100x scalability


🚀 Transformational business impact


Ultimately, governance across endpoints, cloud, infrastructure, and AI systems will continue to revolve around three key objectives:


🔐 Mitigating security risks


💰 Reducing operational costs


📈 Increasing workforce productivity


The future of AI is not just Agentic AI but the holistic ecosystem systems that automates every touch point at scale.


What's your view?
